definitions.gloss: traversing lengthwise; crossing from end to end
definitions.explanation: Traveling or extending through something from one end to the other, typically in a north-south direction or along the longer axis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{列島|れっとう}→列島：11739_rettou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦断|じゅうだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To traverse the Japanese archipelago from end to end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦断|じゅうだん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon crossed through Honshu from end to end.

examples.japanese: ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧{縦断|じゅうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I set off on a trip traversing America from north to south.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦断|じゅうだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to travel the length of ~
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{列島|れっとう}→列島：11739_rettou⟧{縦断|じゅうだん}: traveling the length of the Japanese archipelago
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{縦断|じゅうだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a typhoon moves up the length of the country
- {縦断|じゅうだん}⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: a journey from one end of a country to the other

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{横断|おうだん}→横断：01906_oudan⟧: crossing from side to side; also crossing a street (⟦{横断歩道|おうだんほどう}→横断歩道：06502_oudanhodou⟧, pedestrian crossing).
{縦断|じゅうだん} follows the longer axis of the area, so for Japan it means north to south (or the reverse).
